cv.name: Jasmine Tuhiwai
cv.headline: Communications Advisor – Resources, community engagement & media
cv.summary: Communications professional with three years in the resources sector and local government in Western Australia. I write clearly for very different audiences, from community newsletters to media releases, and enjoy organising stakeholder events.

experience.title: Communications Advisor
bullets: Write media releases, internal newsletters and intranet stories for a 2,000-person workforce
Coordinate community engagement for a mine expansion, including three town hall sessions
Manage LinkedIn and Facebook channels; follower base grew by 40% in 2025
Support issues management and draft holding statements with the corporate affairs manager

experience.title: Communications Officer
bullets: Produced the monthly community e-newsletter and event promotions
Coordinated photography and copy for the annual report
